scope: All fifty states and the District of Columbia

releases.summary: First release. LLM layer, fifteen rules, eleven templates, Tennessee reference layer with a verification file, reader docs, tracker, schemas, examples, validator and tests.

All fifty states. A national baseline on the ABA Model Rules plus one pack per state and the District of Columbia, each in the same eight sections with its own verification file, and routing rules, decision tree and templates that branch on the reader's state.

Maintenance and depth release. A worked example where the client is wrong, a printable one-page decision tree, a tracker-to-chronology exporter, guidance on provable delivery and on finding a local fee arbitration program, national baseline sections on contingent-fee disputes and on a lawyer who has died or left practice, and the New Jersey contingent-fee scale moved onto the Judiciary's own archived site.

Scope-complete release. The first full source sweep ran over every cited URL under references/, and its findings landed in four places: fixes for the rules-layer deadline rule, the tracker validator and the source checker's backreference resolution; a written model of what the checker can and cannot judge in THEORY.md and MAINTAINING.md; a hand re-check of the twenty rows the sweep reported as no longer carrying their claim, every one resolved in place before the release; and a queue in FUTURE_FEATURES.md of the checker work and the loosely-cited rows, addressed to February 2027.
